landing.subtitle: A collection of projects and technologies I've worked on.
landing.profileBio: Passionate about technology and software development from an early age, I enjoy exploring new technologies and continuously expanding my knowledge. I have experience developing web, mobile, and desktop applications, with a strong focus on building modern, scalable, and user-friendly solutions. I thrive in collaborative environments, communicate effectively, and enjoy working with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software and solve real-world problems.
